title: Reject ambiguous shared JSON observations
summary: Require the same unique-key JSON rule in both shared-evidence readers before awarding a PASS.
benefits: Makes the independent implementations agree on ambiguous inputs
risks: Both parsers need a compatible way to detect repeated keys

evidence.claim: Before the v0.0.4 release: The shared example currently decodes the observation using the default object parser.
The Python and Node shared-evidence examples in v0.0.4 reject duplicate keys in observation JSON and preserve the original evidence bytes in failing receipts.

decision.reason: Included in the owner-approved publication of Lydite v0.0.4. https://github.com/vixttha/Lydite-Test-Vault-Template/releases/tag/v0.0.4
